title: Tree Loss

items.label: Fresh Stump
items.description: A walker passes the fresh stump of a large roadside tree in strong sun.
items.visual_focus: a large fresh stump beside a pedestrian in strong sunlight
items.local_cue: a fresh stump where a mature roadside shade tree stood on a Rajshahi paved footpath

items.label: Exposed Roots
items.description: A pedestrian steps around roots exposed by a roadside trench.
items.visual_focus: tree roots exposed by a roadside trench and a foot stepping around them
items.local_cue: exposed roots at a Rajshahi roadside utility trench beside a concrete footpath

items.label: Cutting Branches
items.description: Workers cut heavy branches beside a new utility pipe route.
items.visual_focus: a worker sawing a heavy tree branch beside a new pipe route
items.local_cue: a worker cutting a mature roadside branch beside a new utility trench

items.label: Parking on Roots
items.description: A driver parks on bare soil around a surviving tree trunk.
items.visual_focus: a parked vehicle wheel pressing soil over the exposed tree roots
items.local_cue: a parked battery-run easy bike wheel compressing soil over exposed roots

items.label: Road Expansion
items.description: Road builders measure a new edge that passes close to mature tree trunks.
items.visual_focus: builders measuring a road edge very close to mature trunks
items.local_cue: survey stakes and road works close to mature shade trees on a Rajshahi avenue

items.label: Drooping Sapling
items.description: A small replacement sapling bends in dry soil beside a busy road.
items.visual_focus: a drooping young sapling in dry soil beside the road
items.local_cue: a young roadside sapling drooping in dry Rajshahi soil with a concrete curb

questions: Which two scenes show a tree already damaged or lost?
Where do street trees make a trip better for you in Rajshahi?
Should a project change its route or replace cut trees later? Why?
Why might a road or pipe project remove a mature tree?
If saplings replace it, what must happen for them to survive?
You have 250,000 BDT and 30 days. What one tree-protection pilot would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Protect mature trees along one work-site edge and trial monitored care for replacement saplings; no claim that new saplings replace mature shade within 30 days.

evidence.basis: 2025 Rajshahi reporting on tree removal during development
